source.primary_witnesses: 11Q12 not preserved at this chapter. Greek not preserved for this chapter. Ge'ez (Charles 1902 + VanderKam 1989) is the sole witness.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against VanderKam 1989 + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.citation: VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; Charles 1902; Kugel 2012 A Walk through Jubilees.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 12 — **ABRAHAM'S ICONOCLASM (vv 1-14) + ABRAHAM SETS FIRE TO THE IDOL-TEMPLE (vv 12-14) + ABRAHAM'S DEPARTURE FROM UR (vv 15-21) + ABRAHAM'S CALL (vv 22-24) + ABRAHAM LEARNS HEBREW (vv 25-27) + GENEALOGY TO ISAAC (vv 28-31).** **WITNESS-ATTESTATION: GE'EZ-ONLY.** **CROSS-CORPUS DENSITY EXTREMELY HIGH**: Jub 12:1-14 is THE foundational PRE-RABBINIC ABRAHAM-ICONOCLAST text — picked up by Apoc. Abraham, Pseudo-Philo LAB, Josephus, rabbinic Genesis Rabbah, Qur'an. **CRITICAL Ship A closing chapter — bridges to Ship B (Abrahamic-patriarchal narrative).**

verses.text_geez: ወኮነ፡ በሳድስ፡ ሰሙን፡ በሳብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ይቤሎ፡ አብራም፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ አባ፡
verses.translit: wa-kona ba-sādəs samun ba-sābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu yəbēlo ʾAbrām la-Tārā ʾabbuhu ʾənza yəbəl ʾabbā
verses.notes: **ABRAM ADDRESSES TERAH HIS FATHER.** Abram = age ~14. Bridges from the bird-driving (ch 11) to the iconoclasm-discourse.

verses.text_geez: ምንተ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ወክብር፡ ቦቱ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ዘአንተ፡ ትትፈቅሩ፡ ወትሰግዱ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡
verses.translit: mənta radāʾē wa-kəbər bottu ʾəm-nə kiyāhomu ṭāʿotāt zaʾanta tətfaqqaru wa-təsagdu qədmēhomu
verses.notes: **'WHAT HELP OR GLORY IS IN THE IDOLS that you love and worship?'** **MAJOR — ABRAHAM'S RHETORICAL CHALLENGE TO IDOLATRY.** **CROSS-CORPUS — ABRAHAM-CHALLENGES-FATHER**: cf. Apoc. Abr. 1-8 (the elaborate father-son iconoclasm dialogue); cf. Josephus Ant. 1.155 (Abraham reasons against idols); cf. Bereshit Rabbah 38:13 (Abraham smashes Terah's idols).

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቦቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ጽሙማን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወአቡሰናተ፡ ልብ፡ ወምንተኒ፡ ይክሉ፡ ገቢረ፡ ለርእስ፡ ሎሙ፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma ʾalbo manfasa bottu ʾəmuntu ṣəmumān ʾəmuntu wa-ʾabusanāta ləbb wa-məntani yəkəlu gabira la-rəʾəs lomu
verses.notes: **'THE IDOLS HAVE NO BREATH; they are MUTE; CANNOT THINK; CANNOT DO ANYTHING for themselves.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — IDOL-POLEMIC.** Direct echoes: cf. Ps 115:4-8, 135:15-18 (the classical idol-polemic — mouths/eyes/ears that don't function); cf. Isa 44:9-20 (the satirical idol-polemic); cf. Jer 10:1-16; cf. Wis 13-15; cf. Bel and the Dragon. **The Jubilees presentation is rhetorically tight and structurally clean — anticipates later Apoc. Abr. 1-8.**

verses.text_geez: እሙንቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ስሕተት፡ ለልብክሙ፡ ኢትስግዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ አላ፡ ስግዱ፡ ለፈጣሬ፡ ኵሉ፡ ለዘ፡ ፈጠረ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወምድረ፡ ወአፍላገ፡ ወዘፈጠረ፡ ሰብአ፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡
verses.translit: ʾəmuntu yəkawwən lomu gəʿza səḥtat la-ləbəkəmu ʾi-təsagdu lomu ʾallā səgdu la-faṭāre kwəlu la-za faṭara samāya wa-mədra wa-ʾaflāga wa-zafaṭara sabʾa wa-ʾastaʾtata kiyāhomu la-mawāʿəla ḫəllinā-hu
verses.notes: **'They are a delusion of your heart. Do not bow to them. BOW TO THE CREATOR OF ALL.'** **THE MONOTHEISTIC-CREATIONAL ALTERNATIVE explicit.** cf. Acts 14:15 ('turn from these vanities to the living God who made heaven and earth').**

verses.text_geez: ወያአምር፡ አቡየ፡ አምላከ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘይቤሎ፡ ኢኒሁ፡ ኦ፡ ወልድየ፡ አንሰ፡ የአምር፡ ወምንተ፡ እትገበር፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ ዘይተአዘዙ፡ ሊተ፡ ለመጠን፡ አንሰ፡ ኬብር፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-yāʾəmər ʾabbuya ʾamlāka ḥəywat zayəbēlo ʾi-naḫu ʾo waldəya ʾansa yaʾammər wa-mənta ʾətgabbar la-ḥəzbəya zayətaʾazzazu lita la-maṭan ʾansa kēbr qədmēhomu
verses.notes: **TERAH'S REPLY: 'I know it, my son — but what can I do? They follow me to worship them; if I tell them the truth, they will kill me.'** **MAJOR — TERAH AS SECRET MONOTHEIST.** **Jubilees-distinctive: Terah privately KNOWS the truth but is socially constrained.** This contrasts with rabbinic Terah-as-idolater tradition. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Josh 24:2 (Terah served other gods — opposite reading); cf. Apoc. Abr. (Terah unambiguously idolatrous).

verses.text_geez: ወቅንዓ፡ ጥቀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኢትንግር፡ እምነዝ፡ ቃል፡ ለመነኒ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይቅትሉነ፡
verses.translit: wa-qənʿa ṭəqqa bottu ʾi-tnəgr ʾəmənazə qāl la-mananī kama ʾi-yəqtəluna
verses.notes: **Terah swears Abram to secrecy.** Confessional secret monotheism.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ኦ፡ አባ፡ አንሰ፡ እነግር፡ በ፪ አኀዊየ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlo la-ʾabbuhu ʾo ʾabbā ʾansa ʾənaggər ba-2 ʾəḫawiya ʾəm-nə zəntu qāl
verses.notes: **Abram says he will tell his two brothers (Nahor and Haran).** Family secret transmission.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ኢትንግር፡ ለሎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡ እስመ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ መንፈሶሙ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወያኦፍዑ፡ ኪያነ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትፀለሉ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትፈጥሩ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ለዐመፃ፡ ይኩኑ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlo ʾi-tnəgr la-lomu ʾəm-nə zəntu qāl ʾəsma yəsmaʿu manfasomu kiyāya wa-yāʾofʿu kiyāna la-za yətḍallalu la-za yətfaṭṭəru manfasa la-ʿamaḍā yəkunu
verses.notes: **Terah forbids Abram to tell brothers — afraid they will betray the family.** Heightens secrecy.

verses.text_geez: ወአርመመ፡ አብራም፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወኢነግሮ፡ ካዕበ፡ ካልአ፡ ቃለ፡ በእንተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጣዖታት፡ እስመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ያሰትፍዕ፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarmama ʾAbrām ʾəm-nə qədma ʾabbuhu wa-ʾi-nagaro kāʿba kāləʾa qāla ba-ʾənta kiyāhomu ṭāʿotāt ʾəsma yəfarrəh yāstaffəʿ la-Tārā ʾabbuhu
verses.notes: **Abram falls silent before Terah.** Honor-of-father restrains him.

verses.text_geez: ወበአርብዓ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ አብራም፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሰራ፡ ወለተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾarbəʿā ʾiyobēləwu kāləʾ sabuʿ ba-ḫāməs ʿāmat la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu naśʾa lottu ʾAbrām bəʾəsita səmā Sarā walatta ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita
verses.notes: **ABRAM MARRIES SARAI (daughter of his father — i.e., HALF-SISTER).** **MAJOR — SARAH AS HALF-SISTER**: cf. Gen 20:12 (Abraham himself acknowledges Sarah as 'sister, daughter of my father, not of my mother'). Jubilees endorses this without comment. Jubilees-distinctive: this is a controlled patriarchal sister-wife marriage — the same type as the antediluvian sister-marriages.

verses.text_geez: ወአሮን፡ እኁሁ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለሰብዕ፡ ሰሙን፡ ለለ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሎጥ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾAron ʾəḫuhu naśʾa lottu bəʾəsita ba-sādəs ʿāmat la-sabʿ samun la-la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu kāləʾ wa-waladat lottu walda ba-sābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Loṭ
verses.notes: **Haran marries; Lot born.** cf. Gen 11:27.

verses.text_geez: ወቆመ፡ አብራም፡ በሌሊት፡ በዕለት፡ ሳድስ፡ ለሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ ከመ፡ ያውዕያ፡ ቤታ፡ ለጣዖታት፡ ወአውዐየ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘያአምር፡
verses.translit: wa-qoma ʾAbrām ba-lēlit ba-ʿəlat sādəs la-sābəʿ warḫ kama yāwʿəyā bētā la-ṭāʿotāt wa-ʾawʿaya kwəlu zawəstatēhā wa-ʾalbo sabʾ zayāʾammər
verses.notes: **ABRAM BURNS THE IDOL-TEMPLE BY NIGHT.** **MAJOR — THE ICONOCLASTIC ARSON.** Calendrically dated: 6th day of 7th month. **CROSS-CORPUS — ABRAHAM AS ARSONIST OF IDOL-TEMPLE**: cf. Apoc. Abr. 8 (the elaborate version where Abraham sets fire to the idol-house and fire-from-heaven consumes Terah); cf. Bereshit Rabbah 38:13 (Abraham smashes idols in Terah's shop); cf. Qur'an 21:51-71, 37:83-98 (the foundational Islamic Ibrahim-iconoclasm narratives — both arson + idol-smashing); cf. Pseudo-Philo LAB 6 (Abraham refuses to participate in idol-construction). **The fire-motif is foundational; Jubilees provides one of the EARLIEST attestations.**

verses.text_geez: ወተንሥኡ፡ በሌሊት፡ ለማድኅኖ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ እሳት፡
verses.translit: wa-tansəʾu ba-lēlit la-mādəḫəno ʾamāləktihomu ʾəm-nə māʾkala ʾəsāt
verses.notes: **The people rise to save their gods from the fire.** Continues the dramatic narrative.

verses.text_geez: ወአሮን፡ ቆመ፡ ለማድኅኖ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወአቀደ፡ ቦቱ፡ እሳት፡ ወተውሕጠ፡ በውስተ፡ እሳት፡ ወሞተ፡ በዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ ቅድመ፡ ታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወቀበርዎ፡ በዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾAron qoma la-mādəḫəno kiyāhomu wa-ʾaqada bottu ʾəsāt wa-tawəḥṭa ba-wəsta ʾəsāt wa-mota ba-ʿUr zaKaladāwiyān qədma Tārā ʾabbuhu wa-qabarəwo ba-ʿUr zaKaladāwiyān
verses.notes: **HARAN BURNS TO DEATH TRYING TO SAVE THE IDOLS IN UR OF THE CHALDEES.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — HARAN'S DEATH IN UR**: cf. Gen 11:28 ('Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees') — Genesis records Haran dying in Ur but does not specify cause. **Jubilees provides the fire-death etiology** (= picked up in Bereshit Rabbah 38:13 — Haran refuses to declare for Yahweh or Nimrod when Abraham is thrown into the furnace, hesitates, is thrown in too, dies). **The 'Ur' = 'fire' Hebrew pun (אור 'ur'/'or' = light, אש 'esh' = fire)** is foundational to rabbinic Abraham-in-furnace tradition. **Jubilees here is the EARLIEST attested Abraham-iconoclast-fire narrative.**

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ታራ፡ እምነ፡ ዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ ውእቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ለሐዊር፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወምድረ፡ ከንዓን፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ካራን፡ ወኀደረ፡ አብራም፡ ምስለ፡ ታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ ካራን፡ ክልኤተ፡ ሰሙናተ፡ ዘዓመታት፡
verses.translit: wa-waḍʾa Tārā ʾəm-nə ʿUr zaKaladāwiyān wəʾtu wa-wəludu la-ḥawir mədra Libānos wa-mədra Kanʿān wa-ḫadara mədra Kārān wa-ḫadara ʾAbrām məsla Tārā ʾabbuhu Kārān kələʾēta samunāta zaʿāmatāt
verses.notes: **Terah leaves Ur with his family for Haran (the city) — INTENDING TO REACH CANAAN.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 11:31-32 (the family's Ur → Haran journey). **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE: the journey is explicitly TOWARD CANAAN even before God's call** (whereas Gen 11:31 + 12:1 are ambiguous about whether the family was already heading to Canaan or whether God called Abraham specifically). Jubilees: the family was always aiming for the promised land.

verses.text_geez: ወበሳድስ፡ ሰሙን፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፰፪፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቆመ፡ አብራም፡ በሌሊት፡ ለዕለት፡ ሐዲስ፡ ለሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ ለነጻሮ፡ ኮከብ፡ እምነ፡ ሰርክ፡ እስከ፡ ነግህ፡ ለመጠን፡ ይሬእ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ነገር፡ ለዓመቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝናማት፡ ወቆመ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወይኔጽር፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-sādəs samun la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu za-82 ba-sādəs ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ qoma ʾAbrām ba-lēlit la-ʿəlat ḥaddis la-sābəʿ warḫ la-naṣaro kokab ʾəm-nə sark ʾəska nagə̄h la-maṭan yərēʾ zayəkawwən nagar la-ʿamatu lāʿla zənāmāt wa-qoma bāḥtitu wa-yənēṣər
verses.notes: **ABRAHAM IN HARAN OBSERVES THE STARS to predict rain for the year.** **MAJOR — ABRAHAM AS ASTROLOGER.** Direct continuation of the Chaldean astrology Serug taught (Jub 11:9). **CROSS-CORPUS — ABRAHAM-AS-ASTRONOMER**: cf. Pseudo-Eupolemus (preserved in Eusebius Praep. Ev. 9.17.8-9: Abraham teaches the Phoenicians astronomy); cf. Josephus Ant. 1.167-168 (Abraham teaches Egyptians astronomy + arithmetic); cf. Artapanus (preserved in Eusebius). **Abraham's astrological learning is presented sympathetically — preparing the next verse where he renounces it.**

verses.text_geez: ወቦአ፡ ቃል፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ ወይቤ፡ ኵሎ፡ ትእምርቶሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ወትእምርቶሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወትእምርቶሙ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ኵሉ፡ በእደ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለምንት፡ አንሰ፡ አንተ፡ ምስለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ የኀሥሥ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለርእስ፡ የብለትኒ፡ ጊዜ፡ ለቀርብታ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ቅርብታ፡ ወአንተ፡ ለክፍሉ፡ ለፍቅሩ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይክል፡ ኵሎ፡
verses.translit: wa-boʾa qāl wəsta ləbu wa-yəbē kwəlo təʾəmərtomu la-kawākəbt wa-təʾəmərtomu la-ḍaḥay wa-təʾəmərtomu la-warḫ kwəlu ba-ʾəda ʾəgziʾ la-mənt ʾansa ʾanta məsla kiyāhomu yəḫaśśəśə kiyāhomu la-rəʾəs yəbəlatni gizē la-qarbətā bottu yəkawwən qərbətā wa-ʾanta la-kəfəlu la-fəqru bottu yəkəl kwəlo
verses.notes: **ABRAHAM'S MONOTHEISTIC REALIZATION: 'ALL CELESTIAL SIGNS — STARS, SUN, MOON — ARE IN GOD'S HAND. WHY DO I SEEK THEM AS IF AUTONOMOUS? IF HE WILLS, HE BRINGS RAIN; IF HE WILLS, NOT.'** **MAJOR — THE FOUNDATIONAL ABRAHAMIC MONOTHEISTIC CONVERSION FROM ASTROLOGY.** **CROSS-CORPUS — ABRAHAM'S MONOTHEISTIC AWAKENING**: cf. Apoc. Abr. 7 (Abraham reasons from stars to monotheism); cf. Josephus Ant. 1.155-157 (Abraham reasons from heavens' regularity to a divine ruler); cf. Bereshit Rabbah 38:13 (Abraham's intellectual awakening); cf. Qur'an 6:75-79 (Ibrahim reasoning from stars, moon, sun to God). **One of the most influential passages in all Abrahamic monotheism — the natural-theology awakening.**

verses.text_geez: ወጸለየ፡ በውእቱ፡ ሌሊት፡ ወይቤ፡ አምላኪየ፡ አምላኪየ፡ አምላከ፡ ልዑል፡ አንተ፡ ባሕቲትከ፡ አምላኪየ፡ ወአንተ፡ ፈጠርከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወግብረ፡ እደዊከ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወኪያከ፡ ወመለኮተከ፡ ኀረይኩ፡
verses.translit: wa-ṣallaya ba-wəʾtu lēlit wa-yəbē ʾamlākiya ʾamlākiya ʾamlāka ləʿul ʾanta bāḥtitka ʾamlākiya wa-ʾanta faṭarkka kwəlo wa-gəbra ʾədawika kiyāhomu kwəlomu wa-kiyāka wa-malakotaka ḫarayku
verses.notes: **ABRAHAM'S PRAYER OF MONOTHEISTIC PROFESSION: 'My God, my God, GOD MOST HIGH, YOU ALONE ARE MY GOD. YOU CREATED ALL — I CHOOSE YOU AND YOUR LORDSHIP.'** **MAJOR — THE FIRST ABRAHAMIC SHEMA-PROFESSION.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Deut 6:4-5 (the foundational Shema); cf. Mark 12:29 (Jesus citing Shema). **Abraham's confession positions Yahweh (= the Most High) as his elective covenant-God.**

verses.text_geez: አድኅነኒ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ መናፍስት፡ እኩያን፡ ዘይሥልጡ፡ በልብየ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ወአስተአተት፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ለሙስና፡ ወአንሰ፡ ኪያከ፡ ኬብር፡ ወንሕነ፡ ኬብር፡ ዘርእየ፡ እምድኅሬየ፡
verses.translit: ʾadḫənani ʾəm-nə ʾəda manāfəst ʾəkuyān zayəśləṭu ba-ləbya zayəkawwən la-səḥtata wa-ʾastaʾtat qədmēya zayəkawwən la-musnā wa-ʾansa kiyāka kēbr wa-nəḥna kēbr zarʾəya ʾəmdəḫreya
verses.notes: **'Save me from the hands of EVIL SPIRITS who rule the heart, leading to error and destruction. I will worship YOU — and my seed after me.'** **MAJOR — THE FIRST EXORCISM-PRAYER + INTERCESSORY GENERATIONAL-PRAYER for descendants.** **Bidirectional with Mastema + evil-spirits glossary entries.**

verses.text_geez: ኢትኅድግ፡ ኪያየ፡ እምነ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዐመፃ፡ እንተ፡ ኪያየ፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ድኅረ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ርኩሰ፡ ለክፍሉ፡ ለሥሥዓት፡ ኒሁ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቅዱስ፡ አንፍሕ፡ በላዕለ፡ ልብየ፡ ወአንፍህ፡ በላዕለ፡ ልብየ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወልባት፡
verses.translit: ʾi-təḫdəg kiyāya ʾəm-nə bəʾəsi ʿamaḍā ʾənta kiyāya la-səḥtata dəḫra manfasa rəkusa la-kəfəlu la-śəśʿat naḫu manfasa qəddusa ʾanfəḥ ba-lāʿla ləbya wa-ʾanfəh ba-lāʿla ləbya manfasa ṭəbaba wa-ləbāt
verses.notes: **'BREATHE INTO MY HEART A HOLY SPIRIT + SPIRIT OF WISDOM AND UNDERSTANDING.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE INDWELLING-SPIRIT REQUEST.** cf. Isa 11:2 (the seven spirits on the Branch — wisdom + understanding + counsel + might + knowledge + fear of YHWH); cf. Ps 51:10-12 (David's holy-spirit prayer); cf. Jub 1:23 (above).

verses.text_geez: ምንተ፡ እትሐወር፡ ካዕበ፡ መንገለ፡ ዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ እለ፡ የኀሥሡ፡ ገጽየ፡ እመ፡ እትገብእ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ አው፡ ይዕቅቡኒ፡ በዝንቱ፡ መካን፡ ወአንተ፡ ሤሞ፡ ለመጠን፡ ግዕዘ፡ ሠናይ፡ ቅድሜየ፡
verses.translit: mənta ʾətḥawər kāʿba mangala ʿUr zaKaladāwiyān ʾəlla yəḫaśśəśu gaṣṣəya ʾəmma ʾətgabbəʾ ḫabēhomu ʾaw yəʿqəbuni ba-zəntu makān wa-ʾanta śēmo la-maṭan gəʿza śannāy qədmēya
verses.notes: **'Where shall I go? Back to Ur? Stay here? Show me, Lord.'** **MAJOR — ABRAHAM'S REQUEST FOR DIVINE-GUIDANCE.** Sets up the divine call of v. 22 below.

verses.text_geez: ወፈጸመ፡ ይትናገር፡ ወይጼሊ፡ ወእነ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘእግዚእ፡ ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ ወይብል፡ ግዕዝ፡ እምነ፡ ምድርከ፡ ወእምነ፡ አዝማድከ፡ ወእምነ፡ ቤተ፡ አቡከ፡ ኀበ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአርእየከ፡ ወእገብር፡ ኪያከ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ዐቢይ፡
verses.translit: wa-faṣṣama yətnāgar wa-yəṣēli wa-ʾəna manfasa qāla zaʾəgziʾ boʾa wəsta ləbu wa-yəbəl gəʿz ʾəm-nə mədrəka wa-ʾəm-nə ʾazmādəka wa-ʾəm-nə bēta ʾabbuka ḫaba mədr za-ʾarʾəyaka wa-ʾəgabbər kiyāka la-ḥəzbə ʿabəy
verses.notes: **THE CALL OF ABRAHAM: 'Go from your land and your kindred and your father's house to the land I will show you, and I will make you a GREAT NATION.'** **MAJOR — DIRECT CITATION OF GEN 12:1-2 — THE ABRAHAMIC CALL.** Foundational. cf. Acts 7:2-3 (Stephen's speech locates the call in Mesopotamia BEFORE Haran — Jubilees agrees!); cf. Heb 11:8.

verses.text_geez: ወእባርከ፡ ኪያከ፡ ወአዐብየከ፡ ለስም፡ ወትኩን፡ ቡሩከ፡ በምድር፡ ወይትባረኩ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪያከ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛበ፡ ምድር፡ ወአባርክ፡ ለዘ፡ ይባርከከ፡ ወእትኰነን፡ ለዘ፡ ይረግመከ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəbārəkə kiyāka wa-ʾaʿabbəyaka la-səm wa-tkun buruka ba-mədr wa-yətbārakku bottu kiyāka kwəlomu ʾaḥzāba mədr wa-ʾabārk la-za yəbārkka wa-ʾətkwannan la-za yəragmaka
verses.notes: **'I will bless you... in you all the nations of earth will be blessed... I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you.'** Direct citation of Gen 12:2-3. **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE ABRAHAMIC BLESSING-FORMULA**: cf. Gal 3:8 (Paul cites this as proto-gospel); cf. Acts 3:25; cf. Rom 4.

verses.text_geez: ወእከውን፡ ለከ፡ አምላከ፡ ወወልድከ፡ ወውሉደ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘርእከ፡ ኢትፍራህ፡ እምነ፡ ይእዜ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ አንሰ፡ አምላክከ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəkawwən laka ʾamlāka wa-walədka wa-wəluda wəludəka wa-kwəlu zarʾəka ʾi-təfrāh ʾəm-nə yəʾəzē wa-ʾəska la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam ʾansa ʾamlākka
verses.notes: **'I will be your God + your son's + your grandsons' + all your seed forever.'** **The eternal covenant-formula extended generationally.** cf. Gen 17:7-8.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክ፡ ለነ፡ አርኅው፡ አፋሁ፡ ወዕዘናቲሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይስማዕ፡ ወይትናገር፡ ቃለ፡ በልሳኑ፡ ዘይትከሠት፡ እስመ፡ አጸሙ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ዕለተ፡ ምውዓ፡ ለሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāk lana ʾarḫəwə ʾafāhu wa-ʿəzanātihu kama yəsmāʿ wa-yətnāgar qāla ba-ləssānu zayətkaśśat ʾəsma ʾaḍṣamu ʾəm-nə sabʾ kwəlomu sabʾ ʾəm-nə ʿəlata məwʿā la-sabʾ
verses.notes: **God commands the angel-of-presence (the narrator) to OPEN ABRAHAM'S MOUTH AND EARS — and to TEACH HIM HEBREW = THE TONGUE OF CREATION.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — ABRAHAM LEARNS HEBREW.** Abraham's family spoke Aramaic-Chaldean; Hebrew was lost from the Tower of Babel. Abraham is the FIRST to recover Hebrew, the language of creation.

verses.text_geez: ወአርኀውኩ፡ አንሰ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወዕዘናቲሁ፡ ወከናፍሪሁ፡ ወአኀዝኩ፡ እትናገር፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ በልሳነ፡ ፍጥረት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾarḫawku ʾansa ʾafuhu wa-ʿəzanātihu wa-kanāfərihu wa-ʾaḫazku ʾətnāgar məslēhu ʿEbrāyəsṭ ba-ləssāna fəṭrat
verses.notes: **'I opened his mouth and ears and lips, and I began to speak with him in HEBREW — THE TONGUE OF CREATION.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — HEBREW AS THE PRIMORDIAL/CREATION LANGUAGE.** cf. Targum Pseudo-Jonathan Gen 11:1 (one language = Hebrew); cf. Bereshit Rabbah 38:6; cf. b. Sanhedrin 38b. **The Jubilees-distinctive — Abraham is the FIRST POST-BABEL human to know Hebrew.** Bidirectional with: language-of-creation glossary entries if added.

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአ፡ መጻሕፍቶሙ፡ ለአበዊሁ፡ ወእመንቱ፡ ጽሑፋን፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ ወወሰዶሙ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይትመሀሮሙ፡ እምነ፡ ይእዜ፡ ወአርአይክዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐጥት፡ ቦቱ፡ ወአንበቦ፡ ስድስተ፡ አውራኀ፡
verses.translit: wa-naśʾa maṣāḥəftomu la-ʾabawihu wa-ʾəmuntu ṣəḥufān ʿEbrāyəsṭ wa-wasadomu wa-ʾaḫaza yətmaharomu ʾəm-nə yəʾəzē wa-ʾarʾaykəwo kwəlo zayətḥaṭṭət bottu wa-ʾanbabō sədəsta ʾawrāḫa
verses.notes: **ABRAHAM RECOVERS THE BOOKS OF HIS ANCESTORS — written in Hebrew — and the angel teaches him to read them for 6 months.** **MAJOR — ABRAHAM RECOVERS THE ENOCHIC-NOACHIC LIBRARY!** **The book-chain: Enoch → Methuselah → Noah → Shem → ??? → Terah → ABRAHAM.** Abraham becomes the new scribal-tradent of the pre-Mosaic Hebrew tradition. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 10:14 (Shem holds the books); cf. Jub 21:10 (Abraham cites 'the words of Enoch and the words of Noah' to Isaac).

verses.text_geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ አንሰ፡ እትከሐድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ካልእ፡ ሐቤየ፡ እንተ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ይትከሠት፡ ቅድሜየ፡ እምነ፡ መንገለ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ካልአ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ለግዕዝ፡ ወአንተ፡ አባ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ምስሌየ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlo la-Tārā ʾabbuhu ʾansa ʾətkaḥadə mangala mədr kāləʾ ḥabēya ʾənta ḫabēya yətkaśśat qədmēya ʾəm-nə mangala kiyāhā kāləʾa ḫabēya la-gəʿz wa-ʾanta ʾabbā gəʿz məslēya
verses.notes: **Abraham tells Terah: 'I must leave for a different land — come with me, father.'** Abraham invites Terah to journey to Canaan.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ታራ፡ ሖር፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ሰላም፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ወእመ፡ ትሬእይ፡ ምድረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ለዕዝነ፡ ለነ፡ ወእባእ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ካዕበ፡ ወእነሥእ፡ ኪያከ፡ ናኮር፡ እኁከ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ መካን፡ ለርእስ፡ ቤትየ፡ ወትሰዶ፡ ምስሌከ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlo Tārā ḥor zawəʾtu salām lāʿlēka wa-ʾəmma tərēʾəy mədra lottu la-gəʿz bəḥēr la-ʿəzəna lana wa-ʾəbāʾ məslēka kāʿba wa-ʾənaśśəʾ kiyāka Nākor ʾəḫuka məsla bəʾəsitu zawəstatēhā makān la-rəʾəsa bētya wa-təsado məslēka
verses.notes: **Terah blesses Abraham's departure but stays in Haran — promises to follow if Abraham finds a good land.** cf. Gen 11:32 (Terah dies in Haran).

verses.text_geez: ወይቤሎ፡ አብራም፡ ለታራ፡ አባ፡ አንሰ፡ እትፈትህ፡ መንፈስየ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ወእትገባእ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ካዕበ፡ በሰላም፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlo ʾAbrām la-Tārā ʾabbā ʾansa ʾətfattəḥ manfasya mangala mədr gəʿz bəḥēr wa-ʾətgabāʾ ḫabēka kāʿba ba-salām
verses.notes: **Abraham promises to return.** Final farewell.

verses.text_geez: ወወፅአ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ሎጥ፡ ወውስቴታ፡ ለመጠን፡ ሐጊ፡ ዘምድረ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ወኀደሮሙ፡ መንገለ፡ ሴኬም፡ ለመጠን፡ ዘይከውን፡ ቤተ፡ መካን፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዘኮኖ፡ ብእሲ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድረ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ለዓመት፡ አሐቲ፡
verses.translit: wa-waḍʾa məslēhu Loṭ wa-wəstatēhā la-maṭan ḥagi zamədra gəʿz bəḥēr wa-ḫadaromu mangala Sēkēm la-maṭan zayəkawwən bēta makān lāʿla mədr qədma zakono bəʾəsi lāʿla mədra gəʿz bəḥēr la-ʿāmat ʾaḥati
verses.notes: **ABRAHAM, LOT, AND SARAH ARRIVE IN THE LAND OF CANAAN AT SHECHEM.** **CLOSES SHIP A.** cf. Gen 12:4-6. **Final transition out of the primeval frame into the patriarchal narrative — Ship A → Ship B handoff point.**
